reasoning.ai_enablement: M2 offers the clearest in-silico-to-in-vitro AI-for-Science demonstration because structure interpretation, variant prioritization and experimental handoff can all be represented explicitly.
reasoning.end_to_end_story: M2 provides a coherent computational design → Fab → cell → full antibody → functional validation storyline.
reasoning.m1_comparator_role: M1 remains scientifically useful as a comparator because directed evolution can reveal histidine-independent solutions, but its core search loop is more dependent on physical library generation and FACS screening.
reasoning.critical_thinking: The histidine-centered search bias and avidity/stoichiometry limitations should be surfaced as explicit uncertainties rather than hidden.

downstream_validation_requirement: Where feasible, include an orthogonal assay such as SPR on monomeric Fab to distinguish intrinsic affinity from avidity effects before interpreting cell-binding measurements mechanistically.
